      ChannelIntensityRanges.Builder componentRange(int component, long min, long max)
      Sets the range for the given component by explicit min and max values.
      Parameters:
      component - zero-based component index (e.g. 0=red, 1=green, 2=blue for RGB)
      min - black point
      max - white point (Long.MAX_VALUE = full camera range)
      Returns:
      this builder
